description: Forces the mobile proxy to acquire a new IP address from the carrier (changes the cellular session). This is THE core mobile-proxy feature — agents use it between scraping requests, account creations, etc. Takes ~3-10 seconds and returns the new IP. Costs nothing — IP rotation is included in the subscription. Set verify=true to auto-check the new IP after rotation (adds ~1-2s). Only works on mobile proxies (proxy_type=0) — they are the only ones with a proxy_key.

verify.description: Call proxy_ip after rotation to confirm the new IP

name: rotate_ip
title: Rotate proxy IP
